status.summary: Candidate. One key reads letters 26 to 64 with three letters emended; the head does not read. Not counted as read.

sheet.description: One typed sheet, one typewriter and one carbon, with four transmissions separated by rules.

receipt_stamps.note: the date box is too faint to read on the image

date_note: The transmission line gives only the day and the hour. The month and year come from the ENTRADA stamp of the sheet, 8 December 1936.
sender: Comandante militar de Baleares (Palma de Mallorca)
body: IZSL WFRB YSQV MHRO JHHX EFBL ZJQL NWVB WQCQ GQEZ KCVH XQPO WPRK PJUN SNCK QGKC
notes: Sixty-four letters typed without spaces, preceded by SUR written apart. No header stands apart, and the last group, QGKC, is cipher, not a check: under the candidate it gives the padding SWWW. The interceptor's reference, 13 43 y 17, counts seventeen groups, one more than the sixteen typed, so no header was left out of the copy. Read with SUR in front, the copy falls into a header SURI ZSLW FRBY SQV?, with FRBY in third place and a letter missing from the fourth group, and thirteen groups of text, MHRO to QGKC, ending on WWW: seventeen groups, and no check. The grouping in fours is ours.

uncertain.note: possibly two letters struck over each other; the first would be the missing fourth letter of header group 4, the second the first letter of the text

candidate.key_note: A blind search fixes only the rod positions, 11 12 9 7; windows QCKG with Ringstellung FQBZ is one setting that gives them.
candidate.reading: [letters 1-25 do not read] POSICION MECANI[C]A Y CODIGO ABREV[I]ATURAS [WWW]

emendations.41: the cipher would have to be A (gives C)
emendations.55: the cipher would have to be Q (gives I)
emendations.56: the cipher would have to be M (gives A)

candidate.for: Over letters 26 to 64 its windowed trigram score is the maximum of 2,741,856 decrypts of the message under wrong keys (wiring F, six rotor orders, the whole ring space), 0.3 above the runner-up. The decrypt ends on WWW at letter 64, a multiple of four. One test does not rest on the language model: with the Ringstellung of LUIS (UFSF: same day, same station, same rotor order), the candidate's rod positions give an indicator beginning FRB, and the cryptogram has FRB at letters 6 to 8, followed by Y, its fourth letter if the text begins at letter 13. A given trigram falls somewhere in 64 random letters about once in three hundred. With windows FRBY and Ringstellung UFSF the engine gives, from letter 13, the candidate's decrypt letter for letter.
candidate.against: Three letters have to be emended, and if the tail is a decrypt the head is plaintext too, and it is not Spanish. If SUR and letters 1 to 12 are the header, the message carries no check, and letters 13 to 25, the head of the text, still do not read.
candidate.command_note: The candidate heads the list of candidates that carry a run of W.
